svg.title: Cartographic map — simplified feature geometry
svg.desc: Reconstructed from the supplied map in its original 1843 by 2048 image coordinates. Named layers contain generalized ground-cover areas, subtle worn road tracks and practice circles, sparse ring posts and rails, wall polylines, building footprints, platform outlines, roof ridges, rock silhouettes, trees and tent symbols. Material textures, lighting, photographic cast shadows and small transient objects are omitted. Geometry is visually reconstructed and generalized, not survey or elevation data. There are no embedded images or external resources.

g.inkscape:label: Subtle ground wear and road tracks
